description: This file defines an abstract base class 'Model' within the Goteo project, providing core database operations such as CRUD, data validation, language translation management, caching, and utility functions for models representing database entities.

classes.name: Model
classes.description: An abstract base class for ORM-like data models in the Goteo framework, encapsulating common database interactions, validation, and translation handling for entities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Model instance, optionally rebuilding data from provided array or object, and sets the default table name based on class.

methods.name: rebuildData
methods.description: Populates model properties from an array or object, processing only specified keys if provided.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Initializes the static database connection with optional caching based on configuration.

methods.name: getTable
methods.description: Returns the table name associated with the model instance.

methods.name: getTableStatic
methods.description: Returns the static table name for the model class, inferring from class name if not explicitly set.

methods.name: setTable
methods.description: Sets the table name for the model instance.

methods.name: setTableStatic
methods.description: Sets the static table name for the class.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of the model by ID from the database.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Abstract method to save the model instance; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Abstract method for model data validation; to be implemented in subclasses.

methods.name: transformFieldValue
methods.description: Transforms property values for SQL insertion, handling DateTime, Image, and nested Models.

methods.name: dbInsert
methods.description: Inserts a new record into the database for this model, dispatching creation events.

methods.name: dbUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing database record based on specified fields and conditions, dispatching update events.

methods.name: dbInsertUpdate
methods.description: Performs insert or update depending on whether the model has an ID.

methods.name: dbDelete
methods.description: Deletes the model's record from the database, dispatching delete events.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query with parameters, ensures a database connection exists.

methods.name: dbCount
methods.description: Returns the count of records matching optional filters.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Clears SQL cache.

methods.name: insertId
methods.description: Returns the last inserted auto-increment ID.

methods.name: idealiza
methods.description: Sanitizes and formats strings into URL-friendly IDs, handling accents, special characters, and length.

methods.name: default_lang
methods.description: Gets the default language fallback for a given language.

methods.name: default_lang_by_id
methods.description: Determines fallback language for a record ID in a specific table, with fallback logic.

methods.name: setPending
methods.description: Marks translations of a record as pending.

methods.name: removeLang
methods.description: Deletes a translation entry for this model and language.

methods.name: getLangsAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves all available translation languages for this record.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns list of fields that are translatable.

methods.name: getLangsSQLJoins
methods.description: Provides SQL snippets with JOINs and selected fields for language-specific data retrieval, supporting fallback languages and joins.

methods.name: getLangsPercent
methods.description: Calculates translation completeness percentage for this record in a specified language.

methods.name: getLangsGroupPercent
methods.description: Calculates translation percentage grouped by key fields in related records.

methods.name: getLang
methods.description: Fetches translation data for a specific language.

methods.name: getAllLangs
methods.description: Fetches all translation objects for this record.

methods.name: setLang
methods.description: Saves or updates translation data for this record in a specified language.

methods.name: doPagination
methods.description: Calculates total pages and offset for paginated query results.

methods.name: dbReferencialConstraints
methods.description: Fetches referential constraints for this table to determine foreign key rules.
